update.releaseNotes:
v5.10.20 - YOLO memory leak fix
Fixed ----- - Fixed a memory leak in YOLO stat detection that made each training turn progressively slower and could crash the run out of memory after 10-15 turns. If a run does crash, the reason is now written to the log and shown in a notification instead of the run ending silently. - Importing a settings file with wrong-typed fields no longer crashes the app - bad fields are ignored, keep their current values, and are listed on the Import Preview screen.
